title: Normalization substituting a multi-channel pipette for a single-channel pipette
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load CSV and configure labware
steps.instruction: Upload the properly formatted CSV file that lists the normalization volumes for each well, then load the selected microwell plate (96‑ or 384‑well), the diluent reservoir (place diluent in well A1 if using a multi‑well reservoir), and the P300 and/or P20 multi‑channel pipettes on the mounts specified in the customization fields.

steps.title: Transfer diluent to wells
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel pipette as a single‑channel instrument, pick up the bottom‑most tip in a tip‑rack column (or a new tip each time if the tip‑usage strategy is set to change tips), aspirate the diluent volume indicated for the target well from the reservoir, and dispense it into the corresponding well of the normalization plate. Reuse the same tip for subsequent transfers if the tip‑usage strategy is set to reuse, otherwise discard the tip after each dispense.

substeps.instruction: Pick up one tip (bottom‑most tip in the selected column).
Aspirate the volume specified in the CSV for the current well from the reservoir.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the target well on the normalization plate.
If using the “change tip each transfer” strategy, discard the tip; if using the “reuse tip” strategy, keep the tip for the next well.

steps.title: Repeat for all wells
steps.instruction: Iterate the transfer step for every well listed in the CSV until all wells of the plate have received their specified diluent volume, thereby completing the normalization of the entire plate.
